diagnostic_note: 5 questions x 2 stages on one scenario: a protocol demonstration, NOT a benchmark. Benchmark results: context-growth test run.

cold_start.note: model loading is excluded from every query latency

exact_match.definition: normalized answer == reference; answerable questions (abstention = miss)

f1.definition: token-level F1 vs reference; answerable questions (abstention scored as empty answer)

rouge_1.definition: unigram-overlap F-measure vs reference; answerable questions (abstention scored as empty answer)

rouge_l.definition: longest-common-subsequence F-measure vs reference; answerable questions (abstention scored as empty answer)

bleu_1.definition: clipped unigram precision x brevity penalty vs reference; answerable questions (abstention scored as empty answer)

correct_answer_rate.definition: correct outcomes / all questions (value match, abstain, or conflict as gold says)

incorrect_answer_rate.definition: answered but not correct / all questions

unsupported_answer_rate.definition: answers not grounded in required evidence (or that should not have been given) / answers

answer_error_rate.definition: answerable questions not answered correctly (wrong or abstained) / answerable

unsupported_claim_rate.definition: answers containing an unsupported claim / answers evaluated for grounding

retrieval_failure_rate.definition: not applicable: system does not retrieve

evidence_miss_rate.definition: questions whose required evidence was neither in the context nor retrieved / questions with required evidence

brier.definition: mean squared error of calibrated confidence vs correctness (answers; needs >= 20)

ece.definition: expected calibration error, 10 bins (answers with calibrated confidence)

grounded_answer_rate.definition: answerable questions answered correctly AND citing a required evidence record / answerable

evidence_coverage.definition: required evidence in context or retrieved / questions with required evidence
